authority: Monthly and three-month reserve projections with the money-market-fund route term, using a common monthly sample across exposure definitions and a calendar-quarter comparison.
outcome: delta_reserve_balances (H.4.1, last Wednesday to last Wednesday)

exposures.trc_preferred: core TRC plus the money-fund ON RRP route term (primary; zero before 2013-09)
exposures.trc_core: core TRC without the route term (check)

horizon_definition: For start month t and horizon h: y = sum of the reserve change over months t..t+h-1 and x = sum of the exposure over the same months; every start month gives one overlapping observation; all h months must be present.
controls: intercept and eleven dummies for the calendar month of the start month
window_rule: Start months t with window_end - 47 <= t and t + h - 1 <= window_end, so every summed month lies inside the 48-month window
interval: Conventional Newey-West: Bartlett weights 1 - lag/(L+1) over month distance, L = hac_width (3 for one month; 6 for three-month overlapping sums), scale n/(n-k); nominal pointwise 95% normal interval; not separately calibrated.
scope: Descriptive sample dependence; overlapping windows and, at three months, overlapping observations are not independent; the route term's clock is the calendar month (N-MFP month-end) against last-Wednesday reserves; no landing, retention or causal interpretation.
common_sample: Every exposure uses only the months where all declared exposures are present (ends 2026-06, the last filed money-fund month), so corrected and uncorrected coefficients cover the same months.

horizon_labels.3: three-month horizon (overlapping sums starting every month; not calendar quarters)

calendar_quarter_check: Pooled three-month coefficients restricted to January, April, July and October start months (non-overlapping calendar quarters) are also reported, as a bridge to the quarterly coefficients.
